GlobalEvaluation class

Source: R/global_evaluation.R
GlobalEvaluation.Rd

Internal class. Evaluates the global performance of the STICS model across multiple USMs (User Simulation Models): computes global statistics and performs a comparison of the relative Root Mean Square Error (rRMSE) for the specified variables. Instantiated internally by evaluate.

Details

The evaluation process involves the following steps:

  1. Generating global statistics by comparing simulated and observed data.

  2. Performing a comparison of rRMSE values for the specified variables.

  3. Logging the results and providing a summary of the evaluation.

Active bindings

success

A logical value indicating whether the global evaluation was successful. The evaluation is considered successful if the rRMSE comparison was performed and there are no critical variables identified in the comparison.

skip_reason

Why the rRMSE comparison was not done (e.g. "no reference data"), or NULL if it was done.

GlobalEvaluation$new()

Create a new GlobalEvaluation object.

Usage

GlobalEvaluation$new(
  eval_workspace = NULL,
  usms = NULL,
  var2exclude = NULL,
  percentage = 5,
  output_dir = NULL,
  workspace = NULL,
  logger = default_logger
)

Arguments

eval_workspace

Path to the evaluation workspace. Only used to build a default workspace when one isn't supplied.

usms

Optional character vector of USMs to evaluate.

var2exclude

Optional character vector of variables to exclude.

percentage

Threshold (%) above which a variable is flagged as deteriorated vs. the reference.

output_dir

Output directory for the CSV export.

workspace

An optional EvalWorkspace object. If not provided, a new EvalWorkspace will be created from eval_workspace.

logger

An optional logger object for logging messages. If not provided, the default logger will be used.

GlobalEvaluation$run()

Run the global evaluation. This method performs the global evaluation by generating global statistics and comparing the rRMSE values for the specified variables.

Usage

GlobalEvaluation$summary()

GlobalEvaluation$export()

Export the global evaluation results to CSV files. This method exports the global statistics (global_stats.csv) and, if a comparison against a reference version was performed, the per-variable rRMSE comparison (global_rrmse_comparison.csv, with each variable's status: Critical/Warning/Improved/Not tested/Other) to the csv subdirectory. The rRMSE comparison can be plotted with plot_rrmse_comparison().
